description: This file is a jQuery adapter for CKEditor, providing integration between CKEditor and jQuery, including methods to initialize editors, retrieve instances, and override jQuery's val() method for CKEditor content synchronization.

methods.name: ckeditor
methods.description: Initializes CKEditor instances on selected elements, binds event handlers for instance readiness, data retrieval, destruction, and integrates with form submission.

methods.name: ckeditorGet
methods.description: Retrieves the CKEditor instance associated with the first matched element.
